$comment: Gzip budget of the web app's first load, checked by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs after the web build (CI: Web build). Measured 2026-10-26: entry 296 KB, entry and its static imports 663 KB. Raised to 695 KB on 2026-10-30 for replan-the-day (the missed-block count and packer that Day, Week and Today need before the lazy preview). Raised to 700 KB (entry 313 KB) on 2026-10-30 for calendar-frames: the frame occurrences, the bands behind the Day and Week blocks and the Plan-from-a-frame placement are drawn with the grid (about 3 KB); the Frames dialog is lazy, and lazy bands cost more in shared-chunk overhead than they saved. Raised to 705 KB on 2026-10-30 for calendar-slots (measured 702.8 KB): the slot block with its checklist and details, the slot rows of the phone agenda, the slot start in every list row's time column (TaskRow) and the Schedule sheet's slot choices are drawn on first load (about 4 KB, as design D11 estimated); a lazy details popover measured the same 702.8 KB, so it stays static. Entry raised to 314 KB on 2026-10-30 for bento-daily-check (measured entry 313.1 KB, first load 703.7 KB): the Bento read (sizes, the reconciled slots and the Frog or Summit order) is needed by the Focus engine in the shell, the Loop home and the Daily focus rows of How you work; changing a Bento, the slot rows and the slot menu load with the review screens. Raised to 707 KB on 2026-10-30 for task-energy (measured first load 705.5 KB, entry 313.5 KB): the energy read and its word on every row (TaskRow), the ~deep token in the quick-add parser and its suggestions, the energy filter terms in the parser and evaluator, and the Energy fact, submenu and choice are needed where tasks are drawn and typed (about 1.8 KB, under the 2 KB design estimate); none of it is a screen of its own to load lazily. Raise only on purpose, with the reason in the pull request. Raised to 713 KB (entry 320 KB) on 2026-10-30 for calendar-clarity (measured first load 711.1 KB, entry 318.3 KB): deadline markers on Day, Week, Month and Plan, adding with the pointer (double-click, the add menu, the long press), Colour by for the calendar and boards, the calendar's and Upcoming's query filter with its chip, and the project Calendar layout are drawn with the views (about 5.6 KB against the 3 KB design estimate); the filter dialog is lazy, and a lazy project Calendar layout split ProjectHeader and the views into a shared chunk that measured 8 KB more. Raised to 715 KB (entry 321 KB) on 2026-10-30 for view-manual-order (measured first load 714.1 KB, entry 320.1 KB): the order read of label pages and saved views (lib/viewOrder) and their drag and Alt+arrow handling are drawn with those lists (TaskListView, SavedViewView, about 1.1 KB); the write and its Undo load with the first move. Raised to 716 KB on 2026-10-31 for phone-touch-focus (measured first load 715.4 KB, entry 319.6 KB): the Add to focus / Put in a slot / Remove from focus item of the task menus (the Actions menu, the task panel and page, the Focus screen) needs the focus state where those menus are drawn, and the picker host lives in the shell (about 1.3 KB with the Bento read, which moved out of the entry into the shared chunk); the rules, the writes and the picker load lazily with the first use. Raised to 717 KB on 2026-10-31 for notes-compaction (measured first load 716.4 KB, entry 320.4 KB): the Database storage card is lazy, but its settings copy and search entry (settingsCopy, settingsIndex, read by the settings search in the shell) and the History line that older note versions are kept one per day (task tab and project panel) are drawn on first load (about 0.4 KB). Raised to 718 KB on 2026-10-31 for notes-toolbar-desktop (measured first load 717.5 KB, entry 320.6 KB): the comment composer is part of the task page, which the shell loads statically, and its Formatting toggle now remembers its row on the device and reads the synced Formatting button setting; the toggle and its device state are one small chunk shared with the lazy note editor (0.9 KB with its imports), and the setting row and its search entry add about 0.2 KB. The roving-focus toolbar stays in the lazy editor chunk. Raised to 720 KB (entry 322 KB) on 2026-10-31 for notes-overview (measured first load 719.7 KB, entry 321.0 KB): the Notes page, its search index, the note panel, the snippets of the palette and the append fold are lazy, but the synced note entity (its table, row defaults and content-field rules), the receipt side of pending appends in the sync path, the notes filter terms in the parser and evaluator and their condition-dialog kind, the Notes sidebar entry and its promotion setting, the go and page shortcuts with their cheat-sheet copy, the palette commands and the Trash rows of notes, and the note icon are needed by the shell and the views that load with it (about 2.2 KB against the 1.5 KB design estimate; moving the fold into the lazy rich-text chunk saved 0.5 KB). Raised to 723 KB on 2026-10-31 for series-occurrences (measured first load 722.4 KB, entry 321.9 KB): Day, Week and Month load with the shell, so the projected block, row and agenda item, their selection and capacity share, the Month cell order with projections, the calendar menu switch and the panel's "Projected for" line are drawn on first load (about 2.7 KB against the 1.5 KB design estimate); the walk itself only moved from plan.ts, and Upcoming's projected rows and their math load lazily with Upcoming's switch, which is off by default. Raised to 727 KB (entry 323 KB) on 2026-10-31 for series-exceptions (measured first load 725.8 KB, entry 322.0 KB): completing and skipping a series now read its occurrence records (the exception dates, the done and open count and the jump over them, in recurring.ts and the shared walk), deleting an open occurrence writes its skip, the habit grid reads moved and open records, every projection carries its menu gestures and its drag (the right-click, the long press, Shift+F10) and the list row's repeat mark names its series (about 3.4 KB against the 4 to 5 KB design estimate); acting on a future occurrence (seriesPlan.ts), the projection menu and Move dialog, the panel's scope control and occurrence actions, and the repair after a pull load lazily on first use. Raised to 728 KB on 2026-10-31 for multi-day-tasks (measured first load 727.6 KB, entry 314.7 KB): Day, Week and Month load with the shell, so the span selection and lane packing, the span band's place in the Week header and Month's week rows, the trailing end of a date-only row, the span keys in the calendar scope, the range chip and the "until" chip on every list row (TaskRow) and the Upcoming and Today rules are drawn on first load (about 5.9 KB against the 4 KB design estimate); the bars themselves (SpanBand) and the drag (spanDrag) load lazily when a span is on screen, and Plan, the calendar's least used mode, now loads on first use (2.3 KB off the first load, 7 KB off the entry). Raised to 729 KB on 2026-10-31 for board-polish (measured first load 728.6 KB, entry 308.8 KB): folding a column is drawn with the boards that load with the shell (the project board, a saved view's board and the board of filters): the fold item of the column menu, the strip around a folded column that stays a drop target, the phone pager over unfolded columns, `z` and the keyboard move into a folded column with its announcement, the folded panel of a board of filters, and the Notes on cards switch and project menu item (about 1.8 KB against the 2 KB design estimate); the strip's button and the notes preview (its Markdown-to-text function and the card line) load lazily with the first fold or preview. Raised to 730 KB on 2026-10-31 for accent-colour (measured first load 729.1 KB, entry 310.8 KB): the custom accent is applied by the AppearanceProvider in the shell (reading the stored colour, the cached derived values and setting the four inline properties) and Settings, which loads with the shell, draws the Custom tile with its popover host (about 0.5 KB against the 0.3 KB design estimate for the boot path); the derivation (accentDerive, 5.4 KB raw) and the picker load lazily with the first custom accent or the first open of the picker. Raised to 731 KB on 2026-10-31 for outlook-calendar-sync (measured first load 730.3 KB, entry 312.0 KB): Settings loads with the shell, so the calendar sync panel's Microsoft client row and dialog (client id, tenant check, redirect address, the last refusal), Connect Microsoft and its sign-in results, the Outlook card line and the new reasons are drawn on first load (about 1 KB); everything else of the change is on the server. Raised to 732 KB on 2026-10-31 for obsidian-origin (measured first load 731.3 KB, entry 312.0 KB): the Obsidian note-link check, the chip's note icon, its same-page link and its Copy link menu, and the shell's obsidian-links hand-over are drawn with every task row and the panel (about 1 KB); the check must run on the device after decryption, so it cannot wait for a lazy chunk. Raised to 733 KB on 2026-11-01 for routines-engine (measured first load 732.2 KB): the bell row of a routine notice, the Routine notices channel event, the toast's second action (a run's Undo), the run and undo API calls and the palette command line are drawn with the shell (about 0.6 KB); Run routine… with the step reader loads lazily on use. Raised to 736 KB on 2026-11-01 for theme-engine (measured first load 735.6 KB, entry 313.4 KB, 3.5 KB over main): the AppearanceProvider in the shell reads the theme of each side, keeps the resolved themes the boot script applied, writes their style sheet and device cache and follows the system scheme between the two sides (lib/theme/apply.ts, choice.ts and the token list, about 1.5 KB); Settings, which loads with the shell, draws the Theme row with its theme cards (ThemeList) and the accent row's From the theme state (about 1.2 KB); and the native shells' system-bars hand-over and the bar colour of each side are part of applying the appearance (about 0.8 KB). The derivation, the format validator, the contrast check and the theme documents load lazily, only when a side's theme is not OpenTodo's and its cached result is stale, so nobody on the OpenTodo themes loads them. Raised to 737 KB on 2026-11-01 for routines-editor (first load grew 0.8 KB): the /routines route and its old /rules address, the editor's six keys in the shortcut registry (their cheat-sheet copy), the routine API calls (catalogue, draft test, runs, the Inbox card's route and dismiss), the manual trigger and the sidebar and palette labels are read by the shell (against the 0.5 KB design estimate); the page, the editor, the pickers, the previews, Add step and the run history are one lazy chunk (28.5 KB gzip with the page). With the Inbox card (routines-editor part 3) the Inbox reads whether the account has a routine and Settings draws the Hide successful runs row (about 0.5 KB); the card itself loads lazily. Raised to 738 KB on 2026-11-01 for routines-ai-step (measured first load 737.2 KB, entry 313.9 KB): Settings, which loads with the shell, draws the assistant's routines consent row with its disclosure paragraph, the bell draws the routine_proposal row, and the shell's API module carries the proposal and AI usage calls and the review key of the shortcut registry (about 0.4 KB with the new step-table entries the catalogue reads); the AI cards, the AI settings, the Test question and the proposal review are in the lazy routines chunk. Raised to 740 KB on 2026-11-01 for theme-editor (measured first load 739.1 KB, 1.8 KB over main's 737.3 KB): the shell reads `user:` choices against the synced theme table and re-resolves a custom theme when its row changes (choice.ts, customStamp.ts), the router knows /settings/appearance/themes/<id> and its leave guard, the shortcut registry has the editor's three keys with their cheat-sheet copy, and the Theme row's cards take a menu and the Low contrast mark (ThemeList), about 0.7 KB; the rest is chunk overhead: the editor's primitives load lazily as one chunk (ui/themeKit.ts), and the overlay, Card and theme-choice modules they share with the first load now sit in shared chunks of their own (exporting them through the barrel unlazily measured 2 KB more). The editor (9.4 KB gzip with its preview), the primitives (2.6 KB), the VS Code importer (2.7 KB) and the derivation worker load only when used. Raised to 741 KB on 2026-11-01 for theme-instance-default (measured first load 740.1 KB, 0.8 KB over main's 739.3 KB): the shell resolves an empty side through the server's default and reads `instance:` choices against the server themes this device remembers (choice.ts, which now also holds that small store so the boot path stays one module; a separate module split the i18n chunk and measured 2.6 KB more), the AppearanceProvider re-resolves when they change, Settings draws the Default (Server default) card and the From this server line of a card (ThemeList), and the API module has the four theme calls. Reading the themes again (instanceSync.ts), the Branding card's theme controls (BrandingThemes, with the contrast check) and the derivation, now in a worker of its own at start, load lazily. Raised to 746 KB on 2026-11-01 for routines-ai-step's device runs (measured first load 745.0 KB, 4.4 KB over main's 740.6 KB, entry 312.3 KB): the relay worker in the shell gains the routines opt-in, its capabilities and the routine event with the running state and recent runs (lib/relay, about 1.2 KB), the API module the commit, fail, opt-in and encrypted-apply calls, the bell decrypts a device run's sealed notice, the error catalogue gains the device-run codes and Settings' copy the routines rows (about 1.5 KB together); the rest is shared-chunk overhead: the lazily loaded device planner and runner share small modules with the shell (focus, durations, the query tokenizer and parser, the error messages, the relay), which Rollup now splits into chunks of their own. The planner (lib/rules/run), the runner, the on-device AI call, the encrypted proposal review and the Settings panel load lazily.
